scope: Measured steady-shear constitutive prediction and processing-window benchmark; slit-flow predictions have no observed Q ground truth.
split: All10materials, leave-one-whole-file-replicate-out of5. All temperatures/shearrates in that file heldout. No heldout hyperparameter/model/family/epoch selection.

arms.primary_high_shear: rate>=10/s, allpositive (source torque warning fixed threshold)
arms.full_positive: all strictlypositive viscosity records; 238 nonpositive raw observations retained and scored in rawspace but excluded from logfit

input_normalization: Training-only actualT min/max and actualrate min/max for each material/fold/arm; features scaled reciprocal kelvin and logarithmic shear rate. No target min/max from heldout.
neural_model: logeta = train_mean_logeta + tanh MLP 2x16; exp ensures positiveviscosity, no monotonicityconstraint

optimizer.name: Adam
optimizer.batching: Independentweights, fullbatchpermodel; sum of permodelmean losses; no sharedweights, no datasetshuffle. GPU batched implementation.

symbolic_families: exp(totaldegree1/2/3 polynomial) in normalized1/T andloggamma; allreported, primarydegree2; no free structuresearch
compression: Ordinaryleastsquares on teacherlogeta at61x61uniformnormalizedfeaturegrid withintrainingranges. Eachtemperature/ratecombination equallyweighted in thosefeatures.
direct_refit: OLSsamepolynomialfamily on sameoriginaltraining logobservations; exactconvexoptimum independentstart so directfit=coefficientrefit countedonce, nottwomethods.
metrics: heldoutrawrelativeL2 allfinite inclnegative for fullrange secondary
processingeta<=.4 classification atgamma20 using ownreplicate loggamma/logeta interpolation
crossingtemperature sets, noextrapolation; unique/multiple/unbracketedexplicit; onlyunique-uniquepairs give scalarabsoluteerror
processing_reference: At eachnominalT, interpolate heldoutreplicate logeta vsloggamma to20/s, temperature samebracketweighted; referencepiecewiselinearlogeta vsactualT; useall10T including125 upturn. Modelreference comparison atsameT, allbranchesretained. 0.40 Pa s sourcepracticalprocessingbenchmark, notvalidatedprintability.
physical_checks: eta positivebyarchitecture. Stressincrementalmonotonicity 1+dlogeta/dloggamma evaluated on 61x201withintraininginputrectangle; failures are definitive samples, passes arenotglobalproof. Also report rawstressnonmonotonicity withoutsmoothing.

flow.wall_stress: 40/s times geometricmean viscosity from4trainingreplicates at40/s (eachlograteinterpolationwithinmatchednominalT); noheldoutaccess
flow.method: invertstrictlyincreasingstress only, integrate measured-rate-supportedouterregion. Conditionalunmeasuredcoreband assumesunknowninverseextensionmonotone withPhi(0)=0; no extrapolated centerestimate. Wallstressoutsideinterval->explicitinvalid. 128pointGauss vsindependentadaptivequad
flow.rate_support: At each nominaltemperature panel, max of minimumrates and min of maximumrates over four trainingreplicates afterprimarycut. This common measuredinterval, notglobalnormalizationbounds, restricts inversions.
flow.temperature_evaluation: Mean of fourtrainingreplicate actualtemperatures interpolated at40/s for eachnominal35/75/125panel, reportedexplicitly.

uncertainty: Perwhole-replicate results retained; seedmean first, across5foldSD descriptive. Folds sharetrainingdata, materials selectedexperimentaldesign; no independentN fromtemperature or randomrows; no pvalues.
failures: Allnonfinite/invalid/absentcrossings retained withstatus. No clipping, absolutevalue repair, sortingstress toforceinverse, outlierdeletionbyoutcome, ortruthtuning.
